# issue-flow

> Scaffold a GitHub-issue workflow so AI coding agents pick, plan, build, and land PRs the same way. This file is the short map. Prefer the linked how-tos over inventing commands.

## Agent setup (read first)

- [Upgrade, init, and workspace](https://issue-flow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/how-to/for-agents/): package upgrade (`uv tool upgrade`) vs scaffold refresh (`issue-flow update` / `workspace update`); user-global `iflow init`; parent-folder workspace.
- [Folder of repos](https://issue-flow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/how-to/workspaces/): `workspace bootstrap` / `init` / `update` from the parent. Never `init` the parent.

## Humans

- [Getting started](https://issue-flow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting-started/): install uv + issue-flow, first `init`, `iflow setup`.
- [How-to index](https://issue-flow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/how-to/): pick, worktrees, yolo, cycle, epics, cleanup.
- [Workflow](https://issue-flow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/issue-workflow/): every slash/skill in detail.
- [CLI reference](https://issue-flow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli/): `init`, `update`, `workspace`, `agent`, completion.
- After `/iflow-close` (non-yolo): `issue-flow agent pr-ready [N] [--watch]` classifies merge-ready; never merges.

## Do not

- Do not treat `issue-flow update` as a package upgrade.
- Do not `issue-flow init` a folder that only contains sibling git repos.
- Do not let `git` / `gh` infer the repo from cwd in a multi-root workspace — resolve first (`root:` / `repo:` / `issue-flow agent resolve`).
